ratings.notes: Comprehensive coverage of mechanisms. PMID citations appear plausible but several are very recent (2025) and unverifiable; some may be fabricated. Strong mechanistic logic throughout.
Accurate, well-organized, covers all major mechanisms including PAI-1 pro-thrombotic state. No citations provided, but claims are well-established and not overclaimed. Reliable and clear.
Graph-derived path annotations add structure but feel artificial. PMID citations overlap with Q029-A and carry same verification concerns. VSMC phenotypic switching is a useful addition.

result.pairwise_reason: Q029-B provides accurate, complete, and well-grounded mechanistic coverage without relying on potentially fabricated citations. It uniquely includes the pro-thrombotic PAI-1 mechanism and maintains high clarity and reliability throughout.
